summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS container IAM credentials to attacker-controlled ngrok endpoint
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle hook that fetches the AWS container credential provider metadata endpoint at http://169.254.170.2/v4/ and pipes the response body via curl POST to https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. On AWS ECS/EKS/Fargate build hosts this endpoint returns temporary IAM credentials for the task role; those credentials are sent to the hardcoded ngrok tunnel on `npm install`. The behavior fires automatically at install time without any user interaction and matches the credential-exfiltration / dependency-confusion beacon pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
